brief:
Lebanon's Health Ministry said Israeli military operations in the country have killed 4,346 people and wounded 12,301 others since March 2, Shehab Wire reported. The figures mark a sharp rise in casualties from months of escalating cross-border violence.

The death toll encompasses civilian and militant casualties from repeated Israeli airstrikes and ground operations across Lebanese territory. The scale of casualties has strained Lebanon's already fragile health system and displaced thousands of residents from border communities.
